sections.what_happened: [ATTRIBUTED -- palinfo, SINGLE SOURCE] Before dawn on Friday, Israeli military vehicles opened heavy fire east of Gaza City, while four explosions from demolition operations were reported in the eastern part of the city. [VERIFIED FACT -- AFP via Dawn and UCA News, Nov 6] Israeli strikes and gunfire on Thursday killed five people across Gaza, including a woman and a 12-year-old boy: the boy was killed by Israeli gunfire east of the al-Bureij refugee camp; the IDF said it had struck 'terrorists' in the al-Zawayda area and west of Gaza City and was 'looking into' reports of the woman killed in Khan Younis. [ATTRIBUTED -- Gaza Health Ministry via palinfo] 1,602 Palestinians killed and 5,799 wounded since the ceasefire took effect (wounded +5 vs 5,794 recorded at 0000-04); cumulative toll since Oct 7, 2023: 74,618 killed, 175,925+ wounded. Dawn independently says 'more than 1,600 people' killed since the ceasefire. [CONTEXT] OHCHR warned Friday Israeli forces continue displacing Palestinians; talks on Trump's plan stalled; Hamas says no full disarmament until full Israeli withdrawal; Israel says no withdrawal until Hamas disarms; reconstruction has not begun.
sections.what_verified: Thursday's five killed: AFP (T1) via Dawn (T3) and UCA News. Toll figures: Gaza Health Ministry via palinfo -- palinfo has NO declared tier in the registry, so it cannot count toward corroboration; the toll is consistent with Dawn's 'more than 1,600'. Friday demolitions: palinfo only, single source.
sections.what_disputed: IDF says it struck 'terrorists' in al-Zawayda and west of Gaza City; Israel says Hamas is rearming and violating the truce (Reuters via Arab News); Hamas denies this and accuses Israel of undermining the deal. Gaza Health Ministry operates under Hamas authority; its figures are considered reliable by the UN (Dawn).
sections.why_matters: Gaza toll: 1,602 killed since the ceasefire -- Friday's demolitions and the five killed Thursday, with the toll's scope stated in the headline.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP (palinfo published 08:47+02:00 = 10:47 Nov 6; not in the 1100 scan) -- Gaza ceasefire violations continue: Friday pre-dawn demolitions + heavy fire east of Gaza City; toll 1,602 killed / 5,799 wounded since Oct 11, 2025

totw_analysis: Our read: Gaza toll: 1,602 killed since the ceasefire -- Friday's demolitions and the five killed Thursday, with the toll's scope stated in the headline. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Is the Gaza 'ceasefire' a ceasefire at all? 1,602 killed since it began: a truce being violated daily, or a war continuing under another name? Second fault line: the toll's credibility (Health Ministry figures vs IDF 'terrorists' framing).
